_captured: 2026-10-10, @google-cloud/storage 8.2.0, read-only listing of gs://toast-stats-data-staging with the gate's exact call: bucket.getFiles({ prefix, fields: 'items(name,size,crc32c,md5Hash,contentEncoding),nextPageToken' }). Each element was JSON.stringify'd as returned. Listing metadata only - no object contents were read.
_findings: With `fields` set, getFiles returns the raw JSON-API items as plain Objects (constructor Object, no `.metadata`, no File methods) - bucket.js getFiles: `if (query.fields) return file`.
Without `fields`, items are File instances and the same values live under `.metadata`.
`size` is a decimal string, not a number.
`contentEncoding` is ABSENT (not null/empty) on objects stored without one; present as 'gzip' on time-series objects.
With delimiter + autoPaginate:false, the third tuple element is the raw response { kind, nextPageToken?, prefixes }.
